regulations.title: Rules on the verification of country of melt and pour for imported iron and steel products

in_scope_cn_ranges.description: Flat-rolled products, bars, rods, wire, tubes, pipes and hollow profiles of iron and non-alloy/alloy/stainless steel

out_of_scope_cn_codes.description: Tube or pipe fittings (for example, couplings, elbows, sleeves), of iron or steel
out_of_scope_cn_codes.reason: Explicitly excluded from Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 melt-and-pour evidence mandate. Note: Subject to CBAM embedded emissions reporting under Regulation (EU) 2023/956.

out_of_scope_cn_codes.description: Screws, bolts, nuts, coach screws, screw hooks, rivets, cotters, cotter-pins, washers and similar articles, of iron or steel
out_of_scope_cn_codes.reason: Explicitly excluded from Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 melt-and-pour evidence mandate. Note: Subject to CBAM embedded emissions reporting under Regulation (EU) 2023/956.

regulations.title: Documentary evidence standards for country of melt and pour in customs clearance
regulations.mtc_requirement: Mandatory mill test certificate (EN 10204 3.1 or 3.2) explicitly stating heat number, country of melt, and country of pour.

transition_rules.until_2027_09_30: Standalone mill letter or accredited independent laboratory certificate permitted if heat number aligns with bill of lading.
transition_rules.from_2027_10_01: Mill letter can only SUPPLEMENT the primary Mill Test Certificate; standalone letters are rejected.

regulations.citation: UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Regulations 2027
regulations.title: UK CBAM and Supply Chain Provenance Regime
regulations.notes: Voluntary declarations commence 1 April 2027. Full statutory enforcement mandatory from 1 July 2027. Consignments with total taxable steel value under £2,000 GBP are exempt.

importer_checklist_questions.label: Are all exported goods categorized with valid 4-to-8 digit CN / HS codes?
Is each shipment line linked to a verified primary steelmaking heat number?
Is the country where crude steel was melted into molten form documented?
Is the country where molten steel was poured into semi-finished or finished casting documented?
Does the evidence originate from an authenticated MTC (or permitted supplemental mill letter)?
Is the evidence pack secured with a digital inspector timestamp and cryptographic hash seal?
